generators.carrier: Pauli X-type product on the 4 edges at a vertex in each of three planes: 3 independent vertex operators A_v^{xy}, A_v^{yz}, A_v^{xz}, each acting on 4 edges
Pauli Z-type product on the 12 edges of a cube

relations.statement: All vertex and cube terms pairwise commute: vertex terms with each other (both X-type), cube terms with each other (both Z-type), and each vertex term overlaps each cube term on an even number of edges (0 or 2).
relations.hypotheses: Periodic Lx x Ly x Lz cubic lattice, qubits on edges, Lx,Ly,Lz >= 1 as in the imported paper

lemmas.statement: For small fixed (Lx,Ly,Lz), e.g. 2x2x2 (or 3x3x3), the vertex and cube term matrices pairwise commute, checked by finite computation.
The ground-state degeneracy of the X-cube model on an Lx x Ly x Lz torus is 2^(2Lx+2Ly+2Lz-3).
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem xcube_gsd (Lx Ly Lz : Nat) : True := by sorry

near_misses.claim: The 3D toric code on the same lattice has GSD 2^3 = 8, independent of size, so the X-cube GSD would be 8.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: X-cube GSD grows with linear size (subextensive), the exponent is 2Lx+2Ly+2Lz-3, not constant
Vertex/cube terms have relations that reduce the independent constraint count; the -3 accounts for them, at L=1 the exponent 3 is gives 2^3 not 2^6
